summary.title: Fly.io Distributed Systems Challenge (Gossip Glomers)
summary.one_liner: A series of distributed systems exercises, built with Kyle Kingsbury on the Maelstrom test platform, where you implement cluster nodes and have their consistency checked under injected failures.
takeaways: Maelstrom handles message routing between nodes you implement and can inject failures.
Each challenge verifies behavior against the consistency guarantees it requires.
Documentation is written in Go, but Maelstrom is language agnostic, so challenges can be done in any language.
Start with the Echo challenge to confirm Maelstrom and your setup work.
Get help or compare solutions via the #dist-sys-challenge tag on the Fly.io Community Discourse.
summary.summary: The page introduces a set of distributed systems challenges created by the Fly.io team together with Kyle Kingsbury, author of Jepsen. The challenges run on Maelstrom, a platform built on Jepsen, where you build a node and Maelstrom routes messages between nodes, injects failures, and checks results against each challenge's consistency requirements. The documentation uses Go, but the platform works with any language. The page points to the Echo challenge as a first step and to a community tag for help.
